note: Set A is better because it faithfully transcribes dimension values (e.g., '1'-4"'), whereas Set B incorrectly converts them to rounded integers (e.g., '1 ft' for '1'-4"' and '2 ft' for '2'-4 1/2"'). Both sets share a significant misbinding error where the 10" dimension (depth of W10 beam) is attributed to the C3X6 channel. Set B introduces further hallucinations, such as a weld type 'V' not present in the text and a non-existent 'Detail B', while Set A's primary flaw is redundancy.
